cs.t: I have a G-Lide and I love it for the tide stuff and general toughness. I have Bluetooth disabled though, I want the battery to last like a normal non-smart watch.
cs.th: First G-SHOCK with a heart rate monitor, also featuring Smartphone Link

cs.t: There’s keeping time, and then there’s keeping time without me babying it making sure it never dies, but yes having an internet uplink is a very good way to be on time to the second. I also like the GShock G-LIDE with Bluetooth to set the time from the phones, but then you can put the watch on airplane mode and not worry about it for a few years. It adjusted for DST without uplink by knowing the date and location. It’s got sunrise and sunset without internet too.  https://www.casio.com/us/watches/gshock/product.GBX-100S-1/
